plain_description.what: Re-scores the recorded 12-model arena schedule with the answer key as the verdict: the correct model wins, and undecidable pairs are ties. It then compares this with the real judge boards. No calls.
plain_description.why: Sets the best result any judge or reference could reach on this schedule, so judge results have a fair yardstick.
plain_description.information: Tells how much of the gap to the truth the deployed judge closes. Result: the ceiling is a perfect order (rank correlation 1.0, top 4 exactly right). The deployed judge recipe closes about 43% of the remaining gap in rank correlation and half the top-4 disorder. This is a bound, not a reachable target, and it comes from an older judged set now classed as history.
